text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! New Year's in Japan is awful fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I've had me some of those New Year's dishes… Freshly pounded mochi, mochi soup—the works! It was all delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean I'm done whoopin' it up. I wanna do more!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer! Know any other fun things I could do?
choice_data_list: You could make a New Year's resolution.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, good idea! Grass was just sayin' that too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, I know I wanna be the next Umamusume of the Year…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What do you wanna do, Trainer? Become a millionaire?
choice_data_list: I want to help you achieve your dream.
I want to help you achieve your dream.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're tellin' me we can make both our dreams come true at the same time?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What can I say—our hearts are beatin' as one! Okay, let's work together to make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our resolutions decided, next is to figure out the steps to get there…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well… If I had to get specific…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but thinkin' ain't my strong suit! You're gonna have to take this one, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wasn't expecting to be thrown in the deep end. If we're going to make Taiki Shuttle the next Umamusume of the Year…
choice_data_list: Let's work on increasing your speed.
Let's make sure you rest when you're supposed to.
Let's work on increasing your arsenal.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Increasin' my speed? Oh, I know a thing or two about that! Call it my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness… I dunno what I would've done if you'd said studying.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: N-not that I'm bad at studyin' or nothin', mind you! Honest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vaguely worried about just how poor she must be at studying, I talk her through my ideas for brushing up her speed.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer, just how much do ya know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I was plannin' on rounding up all my friends for some non-stop partyin' this New Year's break…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But all right… I'll get some rest. That's what I gotta do to become Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: …But do ya think I could throw one teensy little party? Just for a single day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not wanting anything to impact our training, I warn her to keep her partying within reason.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Arsenal? Ya mean weapons?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So it's a quick draw ya want! Bang, bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can also throw a mean lasso! Not to mention…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I clarify that I'm not talking about actual weapons, but rather the importance of improving her skills.
